snippet.title: Robosynthesis - Itch.io Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Robosynthesis for free on itch.io: https://knairda.itch.io/robosynthesis

A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center... Robosynthesis is a 3D Action / Puzzle Platformer, where you control SUNNI – the robot who’s just been re-activated after a new ray of sun cracked through their underground facility.

The twist? Your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

Robosynthesis boasts three sprawling levels, each testing your platforming, shooting, puzzling, and resource management skills in many unique ways. A new discovery lurks behind every corner.

Will SUNNI escape the facility... and uncover what happened long ago?
